| Worst MDD | -9.3% | -11.2% | Champion |

## Key Observations

1. **Champion v5 holds** — better tuning consistency and tighter drawdown
2. **Candidate trade-off** — worse tuning min (0.05 dangerously close to zero) but stronger lockbox floor
3. **No blockers** — INCONCLUSIVE queue clear, system healthy

```bash
# 3. Generate diagnostic report for next iteration
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

- fold14 appears to be the stress fold (-9.3% to -10% MDD) — may warrant targeted analysis
